title: Giving Is Happiness
simplified_paragraphs: 从前有个国王，他非常宠爱自己的儿子。这位年轻的王子可以得到一切他想要的东西，然而他却常常皱着眉头，很不快乐。
一天，有一个人走进王宫，对国王说，他有办法让王子快乐起来。国王很高兴地回答：”如果你真的能办成这件事，那你提出的任何要求我都可以答应。”
这个人给了王子一封信，并且告诉王子一定要按照信上说的做。王子照着做了，不久，他就成了这个国家最快乐的少年。原来，信上只写了这样几个字:"每天为别人做一件善事！”
traditional_paragraphs: 從前有個國王，他非常寵愛自己的兒子。這位年輕的王子可以得到一切他想要的東西，然而他卻常常皺著眉頭，很不快樂。
一天，有一個人走進王宮，對國王說，他有辦法讓王子快樂起來。國王很高興地回答：”如果你真的能辦成這件事，那你提出的任何要求我都可以答應。”
這個人給了王子一封信，並且告訴王子一定要按照信上說的做。王子照著做了，不久，他就成了這個國家最快樂的少年。原來，信上只寫了這樣幾個字:"每天為別人做一件善事！”
pinyin_paragraphs: cóng qián yǒu gè guó wáng， tā fēi cháng chǒng ài zì jǐ de ér zi。 zhè wèi nián qīng de wáng zǐ kě yǐ dé dào yī qiè tā xiǎng yào de dōng xi， rán ér tā què cháng cháng zhòu zhe méi tóu， hěn bù kuài lè。

yī tiān， yǒu yī gè rén zǒu jìn wáng gōng， duì guó wáng shuō， tā yǒu bàn fǎ ràng wáng zǐ kuài lè qǐ lái。 guó wáng hěn gāo xìng de huí dá：” rú guǒ nǐ zhēn dí néng bàn chéng zhè jiàn shì， nà nǐ tí chū de rèn hé yāo qiú wǒ dōu kě yǐ dā ying。”

zhè gè rén gěi le wáng zǐ yī fēng xìn， bìng qiě gào su wáng zǐ yī dìng yào àn zhào xìn shàng shuō de zuò。 wáng zǐ zhào zhe zuò le， bù jiǔ， tā jiù chéng le zhè gè guó jiā zuì kuài lè de shào nián。 yuán lái， xìn shàng zhǐ xiě le zhè yàng jǐ gè zì :" měi tiān wèi bié rén zuò yī jiàn shàn shì！”
english_paragraphs: Once upon a time, there was a king who dearly loved his son. The young prince could have anything he wanted, yet he often wore a frown and was very unhappy.
One day, a man came to the palace and told the king that he knew how to make the prince happy. The king replied with delight, “If you can really do that, I’ll grant you anything you ask for.”

The man gave the prince a letter and told him to follow its instructions. The prince did as it said, and before long, he became the happiest young person in the kingdom. As it turned out, the letter contained just a few words: “Do one good deed for someone else every day!”
english_full:
Once upon a time, there was a king who dearly loved his son. The young prince could have anything he wanted, yet he often wore a frown and was very unhappy.

One day, a man came to the palace and told the king that he knew how to make the prince happy. The king replied with delight, “If you can really do that, I’ll grant you anything you ask for.”

The man gave the prince a letter and told him to follow its instructions. The prince did as it said, and before long, he became the happiest young person in the kingdom. As it turned out, the letter contained just a few words: “Do one good deed for someone else every day!”
